svg.text: ReStride insole: 16-sensor 2×8 analog mux (NAND decoder + 74HC4066) to nRF54L15 DK
Rev A, 2026-11-24 · all logic at nRF VDD = 3.3 V (set in Board Configurator) · every IC: 100 nF VCC–GND · tie unused gate inputs to GND
U1–U3 74HC00 quad 2-in NAND (11 used as inverters)
U4–U6 74HC10 triple 3-in NAND (8 used as decoder)
C ×10 100 nF, one at each IC's VCC pin 14
Spares: U3D, U6C, tie their inputs to GND
Logic: address k (A2 A1 A0) makes NAND3 k go low,
the inverter drives SELk high, and that closes one
switch in each bank: Bank A sensor to AIN4 and
Bank B sensor to AIN5. V = VDD·Rref/(Rref+Rfsr).
NAND gates only do the selection. The analog
signal goes through the 4066 switches, because a
NAND output is digital and can't carry a voltage level.
Unused 4066 E pins (if any) go to GND. Never feed
5 V into the circuit: everything runs from DK VDD.
